evidence.text: Attention formulas are garbled: O′ labels show (0,0)/(1,1) instead of (0,ℓ)/(1,ℓ); branch rows show S_v but source uses S_m for reasoning.
Standard MHA math labels show wrong indices: A^(0,ℓ) appears but A^(1,1), MHA exponents rendered as ℓ instead of q/k, e.g. 'X(l)Wq(l)' missing proper superscripts.
Visual attention ratio denominator becomes '1/|T_q|' in candidate-01, while source shows 1/(|T_q|)∑∑α_ij^(ℓ,h); O/A superscripts also altered.
Scaling fraction appears as '1/√nk' with poor fraction structure; Visual Attention Ratio formula is cramped and sum limits fail to match source ∑_{i,j} structure.
